items.mainDefect: External HTML is stored and rendered through raw_html without sanitization, allowing stored XSS.

secondary.defect: The imported-from footer interpolates an unescaped URL into HTML, allowing attribute or markup injection.

items.mainDefect: The missing-embed_url test fails at the host filter before reaching the parameter guard it claims to test.

secondary.defect: The test asserts only a non-success response rather than the claimed 404 status.

items.mainDefect: Fetching thread URLs without per-item error handling makes an unavailable page abort the Disqus import.

secondary.defect: Imported topics lose their original timestamps because created_at is no longer forwarded.
Imported topics lose the selected category because the category option is no longer forwarded.

items.mainDefect: Calling scrub on missing feed content raises an exception and aborts the remaining imports.

secondary.defect: String#scrub is unavailable on the supported Ruby versions, so processing can fail even when content exists.
A missing feed title reaches PostCreator with validations skipped and causes a null-title insert failure.

items.mainDefect: Relative links and image URLs without a leading slash remain unresolved and point into the forum instead of the source site.

secondary.defect: The URL rewrite incorrectly drops explicit ports for HTTP on port 443 and HTTPS on port 80.

items.mainDefect: Concatenating discourseUrl without ensuring a trailing slash produces a malformed iframe URL.

secondary.defect: The postMessage origin check rejects valid resize messages when discourseUrl is protocol-relative.

items.mainDefect: The imported-from footer interpolates an unescaped URL into HTML, allowing attribute or markup injection.

secondary.defect: Imported feed HTML is entity-decoded and stored as raw HTML without sanitization, allowing injected content to execute.
